exclusions.source_text: Based on echocardiography, must have either left ventricular fractional shortening =\< 28.0% or ejection fraction =\< 50.0% on at least two occasions
No evidence of poor or low cardiac function at time of initial osteosarcoma diagnosis

Must not have been diagnosed with any subsequent malignancy that required additional cardiotoxic therapies (i.e., radiotherapy to the chest \[also includes fields directed towards the neck, upper abdomen, or spine\], or additional anthracyclines or anthraquinones)
< 31 years of age at time of initial osteosarcoma diagnosis
